errors.evidence: The description states the x-axis data points start at approximately 200. While the exact value is not labeled, the first data point is positioned more than halfway between the origin and the first tick mark at 500, making an estimate of ~300 more visually accurate.

The description states the AlphaEdit Efficacy_top line begins at approximately 99.5. Visually, this line (light red, dashed) starts at approximately 99.0. It is the DeltaEdit Efficacy_top line (light purple, dashed) that starts at approximately 99.5.

The description states that the AlphaEdit Efficacy_top line declines to roughly 95.8 at x=2000. The actual value for this line (light red, dashed) at x=2000 is approximately 97.5. The value 95.8 is closer to the value for the DeltaEdit line at x=2500 (approx. 95.7).
The description claims the DeltaEdit Efficacy_top line decreases to 97.1 at x=2000. The actual value for this line (light purple, dashed) at x=2000 is approximately 98.1.

The description states that the AlphaEdit Efficacy_top line (dashed red) begins at approximately 99.5. However, the first data point for this line is at approximately 99.0. The value 99.5 is the starting point for the DeltaEdit Efficacy_top line (dashed purple).
